title: Pay for advertising jobs
summary: He says street advertising paid a dollar to a dollar and a quarter, plus pay from the dance itself.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Um, how much did they get paid for those jobs on the street?

Is that, oh my God, you want me to say this? Well, I tell you, at that time I have, uh, got no more than, uh, for advertising. Sometime you got a dollar and a quarter. Sometime you got a dollar. For the advertising.
And that was always, usually to advertise a dance, was it?

Yeah, that was for the dance for that night. For that night. Yeah. And you got a dollar, sometime you got a dollar, sometime you got a dollar and a quarter. How long would you be out on the street? Now the dance would play, where you're playing at would pay you a dollar and a quarter. You see? So then you made about two and a half there, you know, on that deal. So that was a pretty good deal at that time. Yeah, that was pretty good at that time. Yeah, that was good.
